description.title: Mushlam Nursing - בדיקת יכולת ביצוע פעולות יומיומיות
description.summary: This table details how Clalit Health Services' Mushlam Nursing policy assesses an insured individual's ability to perform daily activities for claim eligibility. It outlines the criteria used to determine dependency levels for actions like bathing and dressing.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת כיצד פוליסת 'מושלם סיעודי' של שירותי בריאות כללית מעריכה את יכולתו של המבוטח לבצע פעולות יומיומיות לצורך קביעת זכאות לתביעה. הפוליסה בוחנת את הצורך בסיוע בפעולות כמו רחצה והלבשה, תוך התחשבות בשינויים החלים החל מ-01/01/2025. הטבלה רלוונטית לפוליסת 'מושלם סיעודי' לחברי כללית, ונועדה לסייע בהערכת תלות המבוטח. הפעולות הנבדקות כוללות רחצה והלבשה, כאשר הפוליסה מתייחסת גם לצורך בסיוע בכניסה ויציאה מהאמבטיה/מקלחת, וכן ליכולת ללבוש בגדים מותאמים.  הערכה זו נעשית על בסיס הצורך בסיוע בפעולות אלו, תוך התחשבות במצבו של המבוטח.  החל מ-01/01/2025, הצורך בסיוע בכניסה ויציאה מהאמבטיה/מקלחת לא ייבדק.
notable_values: Bathing: Assistance with entering/exiting bath/shower is not inspected after 01/01/2025
Dressing: Adapted clothing/accessories not deemed inability after 01/01/2025

sketch:
Bathing - the company takes into account for the purpose of examining the insured's ability to independently perform a substantial part of the operation, including the need for assistance 0getting in and out of a bath/shower. In this case, the company weights-up the assistance required for the actual bathing action with the insured's ability to enter and exit the bath/shower.
*In the Mushlam Nursing policy for Clalit Health Services members, where the insured event occurred from 01/01/2025 onwards, the need for assistance entering and exiting the bath/ shower shall not be inspected.
Dressing - for the purpose of examining the insured's ability to independently perform a substantial part of the action, the company shall also take into account the ability to put on a variety of clothing items. In the event of a need to attach an artifcial limb, the assistance required for the dressing action shall be weighted-up with assistance required to attach the artifcial limb.
*In the Mushlam Nursing policy for Clalit Health Services members, where the insured event occurred from 01/01/2025 onwards, the insured's ability to wear dress clothing adapted to the insured's condition or with the assistance of an accessory in performing the action - shall not be deemed inability by the insured to perform the action.

טבלה: Mushlam Nursing - בדיקת יכולת ביצוע פעולות יומיומיות
This table details how Clalit Health Services' Mushlam Nursing policy assesses an insured individual's ability to perform daily activities for claim eligibility. It outlines the criteria used to determine dependency levels for actions like bathing and dressing.
ממדים: Daily living activities (e.g., Bathing, Dressing), Assessment criteria and policy details

Bathing - the company takes into account for the purpose of examining the insured's ability to independently perform a substantial part of the operation, including the need for assistance 0getting in and out of a bath/shower. In this case, the company weights-up the assistance required for the actual bathing action with the insured's ability to enter and exit the bath/shower.
*In the Mushlam Nursing policy for Clalit Health Services members, where the insured event occurred from 01/01/2025 onwards, the need for assistance entering and exiting the bath/ shower shall not be inspected.
Dressing - for the purpose of examining the insured's ability to independently perform a substantial part of the action, the company shall also take into account the ability to put on a variety of clothing items. In the event of a need to attach an artifcial limb, the assistance required for the dressing action shall be weighted-up with assistance required to attach the artifcial limb.
*In the Mushlam Nursing policy for Clalit Health Services members, where the insured event occurred from 01/01/2025 onwards, the insured's ability to wear dress clothing adapted to the insured's condition or with the assistance of an accessory in performing the action - shall not be deemed inability by the insured to perform the action.
